decided: Amends the first workspace-72o decision after review round 1: the ungrounded-leg contract extends beyond RenderText/RenderMarkdown to Summary() and gains a structural marker — Leg.Unavailable and EstLeg.Unavailable bools set by Compute's degradation branches. Summary renders 'realized n/a' / 'deferred n/a' / 'unrealized n/a' off that field, never a plausible zero; markdown caveats become '> - ' list items separated from the never-sum disclaimer.
why: Review confirmed Summary() — the line the four incident-tool writers PATCH into vendor impact fields — still rendered 'deferred [deterministic] none in-flight' for an ungrounded leg, and the first decision's 'no renderer drops a label' claim was false for it. A bool the renderer checks beats sniffing the 'unavailable:' caveat-string prefix: the contract is a field, not a string format.
cost_if_wrong: A public-struct field addition pre-v1 (backward compatible; JSON gains an Unavailable key). If the n/a marker is too terse for a vendor field, the fix is wording, not structure.
alternatives: String-prefix sniffing of 'unavailable:' caveats in report package — rejected: couples renderers to Compute's message format
Park Summary as a follow-up bead — rejected: the dishonest zero lands in PagerDuty/incident.io/FireHydrant/Rootly impact fields, the highest-visibility surface this item exists to fix
Render full caveat text in Summary — rejected: it is a one-line vendor field; the why rides the JSON report
scope: engine/engine.go (Leg/EstLeg field + Compute branches), engine/report/summary.go, engine/report/render.go markdown formatting, tests and goldens. Supersedes the first shard's RenderText/RenderMarkdown-only scope.
